19.de: Against a dull yellowish-green background, a lush branch with large fleshy leaves bearing six large white bell-shaped flowers.

20.de: Trees on the left and right, a green slope in the middle. In the distance, in a light haze, the silhouette of the dome of St. Peter's Basilica and the surrounding buildings. Sky blue, partly cloudy. Light falling from the left illuminates the stones and the hill.

23.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis pöördega vasakule, seljas pruun kuub. Esiplaanil palett.
23.de: Bust of a man in half-profile turned to the left, wearing a brown coat. In the foreground a palette.

31.de: Seated full figure of a woman. Head in profile to the left. Right hand in her lap, left resting on a pedestal and holding a stringed instrument. Green skirt and red apron.

6318.d: Esialal pargivaade, künkal Haapsalu linnuse varemed, mis osaliselt nähtavad ka keskel ja paremal pargi puude vahelt.
6318.de: Foreground park view, on a hill the ruins of Haapsalu Castle, which are also partially visible in the centre and on the right through the park trees.

6319.dm: lehe laius: 50.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 21.6 cm
6319.d: Ees paremal madal kivine rannariba üksikute kidurate mändidega, kaugemal kuusik. Vasakul kuni silmapiirini ulatuv meri, kaldaäärne kividerohke, üksiku lootsikuga.
6319.de: In the foreground on the right a low stony strip of coast with scattered stunted pines, further away a spruce grove. On the left the sea extending to the horizon, the shoreline stony, with a single boat.

6327.d: Esiplaanil linnuse varemed, taga keskel paistab üle katuste kirikutorn, paremal rida lehtpuid.
6327.de: In the foreground the ruins of a fortress, behind in the center a church tower is visible above the roofs, on the right a row of deciduous trees.

6328.dm: lehe laius: 43.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm
6328.d: Ees paremal näha üksikuid  põllu- ja maakivist varemeis müüri ja mäekallakul kasvava lehtpuu-tuka latvu. Vasakul all madal rohtunud järvekallas. Keskel eest vasakult taha paremale laiuv järv. Taamal vasakul vastaskallas põldudega metsaviirg.
6328.de: In the foreground on the right, isolated ruined walls of field- and quarry-stone and the tops of a stand of deciduous trees growing on a hillside are visible. At the bottom left, a low, grassy lake shore. In the middle, a lake widening from left to right in the foreground. Beyond, on the left, the opposite shore with fields and a strip of forest.

6330.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt en face. Hallid juuksed, must kuub, vest ja kaelasida. Rohekas taust.
6330.de: Bust portrait of an older man en face. Grey hair, black coat, waistcoat and cravat. Greenish background.

6584.d: Põskhabemega mehe poolfiguur 3/4 profiilis pöördega paremale, mundris, epolettidega.
6584.de: Half-figure of a man with sideburns in 3/4 profile turned to the right, in uniform, with epaulettes.

6590.d: Hallipäise, ebasümmeetrilise näoga mehe rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Pea kallutatud kergelt ette, paremale.
6590.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired man with an asymmetrical face, almost en face. Head tilted slightly forward, to the right.

6788.dm: lehe laius: 28.8 cm; lehe kõrgus: 22.3 cm
6788.d: Nelja kõrvuti istuva reisija põlvpilt: vasakul magav punase pearätikuga tüdruk. Keskel kaks meest. Paremal naine. Taustaks: must postitõlla tagasein, aknakesega selle keskel.
6788.de: Knee-length portrait of four travellers sitting side by side: on the left a sleeping girl with a red headscarf. In the middle two men. On the right a woman. Background: the black rear wall of a mail coach, with a small window in its centre.

7125.d: Keskel noor tumedajuukseline naine, seljas punane pihik ja triibuline seelik valge põllega, peas valge tanu. Vasaku käe kõrval väike tüdruk, paremas käes korv. Paremal tüdruku poole vaatav koer. Tagapool vasakul känd ja põõsaid, paremal põõsapuhmas. Taevas pilves.
7125.de: In the centre a young dark-haired woman, wearing a red bodice and a striped skirt with a white apron, a white cap on her head. Next to her left hand a small girl, in her right hand a basket. On the right a dog looking towards the girl. Behind on the left a stump and bushes, on the right a bush clump. Sky cloudy.

7198.d: Esiplaanil palgil istuv eesti rahvarõhvais naine lapsega. Tagapool, paremal humalad. Keskel ja vasakul vaade üle lagendiku kaugusse.
7198.de: In the foreground an Estonian woman in folk costume sitting on a log with a child. Behind, on the right, hops. In the centre and on the left a view across a clearing into the distance.

7203.d: Naise poolfiguur tugitoolis istuvana. Kehapööre paremale, pea pööratud vasemale. Helesinises rõivastuses ja samavärvilises peakattes, vasemas käes lüüra. Taustaks vasemal sein, paremal maastik.
7203.de: Half-figure of a woman sitting in an armchair. Body turned to the right, head turned to the left. Dressed in light blue with a headdress of the same colour, a lyre in her left hand. Background on the left a wall, on the right a landscape.

7209.d: Vasakul Kristuse istuv täisfiguur, paremal seisev noor naine kruusiga paremal õlal. Taustaks kaljud ja taevas.
7209.de: On the left the seated full figure of Christ, on the right a standing young woman with a jug on her right shoulder. Background of cliffs and sky.

7211.d: Kaljukoopas keskel inglifiguur valges pikas rüüs, ovaal ümber pea, üle vasaku õla heidetud drapeeritud kangas. Keha profiilis paremale, pea otsevaates, pilk suunatus vasakule. Parem käsi otsustavalt kõrgele tõstetud. Ees paremal, kivil, valge linariba. Vasakul taga paistab läbi koopasuu taevas, all väikest vegetatsiooni. Kujutus ebakindla kontuuriga ovaalis.
7211.de: In the middle of a rock cave, an angel figure in a long white robe, an oval around the head, draped fabric thrown over the left shoulder. The body in profile to the right, the head in frontal view, the gaze directed to the left. The right hand decisively raised high. In front, on the right, on a stone, a white strip of linen. Behind on the left, the sky can be seen through the mouth of the cave, below some small vegetation. The depiction is in an oval with an uncertain contour.

7214.d: Noore naise täisfiguur otsevaates, pea kerge pöördega paremale; peas laia äärega küber, millel sulg ja paremas käes lehvik. All kitsas maastiku riba.
7214.de: Full figure of a young woman in a frontal view, her head slightly turned to the right; on her head a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, and in her right hand a fan. Below, a narrow strip of landscape.

7221.d: Lühikest põskhabet kandva mehe rinnapilt, peaaegu otsevaates en face. Frakil metallnööbid.
7221.de: A bust portrait of a man with a short side-beard, almost in a direct en face view. Metal buttons on the tailcoat.

7309.d: Vanema tumedajuukselise naise põlvpilt harmooniumi ees istuvana. Keha kerge pöördega paremale nägu poolprofiilis vasakule. Must taftkleit kitsa valge pitskaeluse ja kätistega.  Peas valge pitstanu. Süles käte vahel avatud raamat. Paremal harmooniumi nurgal vaas lilledega; vasakul, laual väike skulptuurigrupp loomadega.
7309.de: A knee-length portrait of an older dark-haired woman sitting in front of a harmonium. The body slightly turned to the right, the face in three-quarter profile to the left. A black taffeta dress with a narrow white lace collar and cuffs. On the head a white lace cap. In her lap, between her hands, an open book. On the right corner of the harmonium a vase with flowers; on the left, on a table, a small sculpture group with animals.

7333.d: Esiplaanil puupakul istuv rahvarõivais naine lapsega. Triibuline seelik, sinisega tikitud käised, kollane pottmüts.
7333.de: A woman in folk costume sitting on a wooden block in the foreground, with a child. Striped skirt, sleeves embroidered with blue, yellow pot-shaped cap.

7334.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur pöördes paremale, nägu pööratud otse vaataja poole. Sügava kaelusega roheline kleit, õlgadel lopsakate voltidena kukkuv hall ülevise. Paremal laual avatud raamat ja karikas ussiga. Naise vasakus käes pärgamendi rull. Vasakus ülanurgas kotkas.
7334.de: Half-figure of a seated woman turned to the right, face turned directly towards the viewer. Green dress with a deep neckline, a grey overgarment falling in lush folds on the shoulders. On a table to the right an open book and a chalice with a snake. In the woman's left hand a parchment scroll. In the upper left corner an eagle.

7340.d: Jämedal puutüvel istub külgvaates noor blond naine Põhja-Eesti rahvariietes (sini-puna-beeži pikitriibuline seelik, valge põll, sinise tikandiga pluus, kullaga tikitud pottmüts), pea pööratud vaatajale. Parem käsi lapse seljal, kes teiseltpoolt puutüve toetub naise najale, vasakuga hoiab lapse kätt süles. Laps heledajuukseline, punapõskne, seljas valge särk, peas pärg. Vasakul pool figuuri osa suurema puu tüvest, paremal ronitaimed. Silmapiiril, sinakas udus Tallinna siluett.
7340.de: On a thick tree trunk sits, in profile, a young blonde woman in North Estonian folk costume (blue-red-beige longitudinally striped skirt, white apron, blouse with blue embroidery, gold-embroidered pot-shaped cap), her head turned towards the viewer. Her right hand is on the back of a child, who leans against the woman from the other side of the trunk; with her left hand she holds the child's hand in her lap. The child is fair-haired, rosy-cheeked, wearing a white shirt, a wreath on its head. To the left of the figure, part of the trunk of a larger tree; on the right, climbing plants. On the horizon, in a bluish haze, the silhouette of Tallinn.

7519.d: Noore naise rinnapilt  poolprofiilis vasemale, paljaste õlgadega, valges õhulises kleidis. Portreed ümbritseb ovaal.
7519.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in half-profile to the left, bare-shouldered, in a light, airy white dress. The portrait is surrounded by an oval.

7546.d: Esiplaanil vasakul muru, paremal põld. Murul kolm inimest, põllu paremas osas viis inimest. Taga puude vahelt näha keskel kahte suurt valget maja ja vasakul ühe väikese majakese katust korstnaga.
7546.de: In the foreground on the left grass, on the right a field. Three people on the grass, five people in the right part of the field. Behind, among the trees, two large white houses can be seen in the middle and the roof with a chimney of one small house on the left.

7577.d: Ees, ühel hobusel ratsutavad mees ja naine. Taga vaade alla orus olevale kirikutornile ja metsale.
7577.de: In front, a man and a woman riding on one horse. Behind, a view down into a valley with a church tower and forest.

7583.d: Teekurvil kaldapervele toetuv seljapaunaga kaabus mees (autor). Mehe ees kaks väikest seisvat tüdrukukest.
7583.de: A capped man with a knapsack (the author) leaning on the bank edge at a bend in the path. In front of the man, two small standing little girls.

7632.d: Esiplaanil org, paremal künkal puu, vasakul org puudega ja meri.
7632.de: In the foreground a valley, on the right a hill with a tree, on the left a valley with trees and the sea.

7633.d: Esiplaanil vasakul jõgi, paremal mets, keskel tee kahe naisratsutaja ja ühe jalakäijaga. Taustaks mäed ja keskel loss kaljul.
7633.de: In the foreground on the left a river, on the right a forest, in the middle a road with two female riders and one pedestrian. In the background mountains and in the middle a castle on a cliff.

7634.d: Esiplaanil keskel kaks meesfiguuri, paremal kuusemets, vasakul järsult kõrgele tõusev kaljusein mille taustaks mäed. Alumises osas näha koopasuu. Selle kõrval viltu vajunud puuriit krutsifiksiga.
7634.de: In the foreground, centre, two male figures, on the right a spruce forest, on the left a steeply rising rock wall with mountains in the background. In the lower part a cave mouth can be seen. Beside it a crookedly leaning woodpile with a crucifix.

7635.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Juuksed, habe  ja vurrud hallid. Ümbritseb rohekas ovaal pruunis toonis taustal.
7635.de: Bust of an elderly man in three-quarter profile to the right. Hair, beard and moustache grey. Surrounded by a greenish oval on a brown-toned background.

7745.d: Ees keskel pruun rohtu sööv lammas. Fooniks põõsastik.
7745.de: In the front center, a brown sheep grazing. Bushes in the background.

7749.d: Interjööris laua ümber istuv perekond isa, ema ja kolm tütart. Taga seinal tumedajuukselise noormehe portree istuvas asendis.
7749.de: In the interior a family sitting around a table: father, mother and three daughters. On the wall behind, a portrait of a dark-haired young man in a sitting position.

7815.d: Esiplaanil jõekallas, vasemal tara ja majanurga kõrval naine seakarjaga, ratsanik ja väike poiss pardikarjaga, nende taga sild, küün ja palgivirnad; paremal veepinnale kummardunud puud. Taamal mets, vasakul poolpilves taevas.
7815.de: In the foreground a riverbank, on the left a fence and, beside the corner of a house, a woman with a herd of pigs, a rider and a small boy with a flock of ducks, behind them a bridge, a barn and stacks of logs; on the right trees bending over the water's surface. In the distance forest, on the left a partly cloudy sky.

7952.d: Esiplaanil paremal kivine rand kaldale veetud purjepaadiga. Vasakul meri. Paadi taga kuivatussaadustel võrgud. Taevas pilvine.
7952.de: In the foreground right a stony shore with a sailing boat drawn up onto it. On the left the sea. Behind the boat nets on drying racks. Sky cloudy.

8335.d: Pruunide juuste ja põskhabemega keskealise, vaimuliku talaaris mehe rinnapilt en face. Pea kummardanud kergelt allapoole.
8335.de: Bust portrait en face of a middle-aged man with brown hair and side-whiskers, wearing a clergyman's cassock. Head bowed slightly downward.

8463.d: Vanema naise poolfiguur en face, kehapöördega vasakule, parem käsi ees. Tanu, kaelus ja kätised valged, tumedal kleidil pross.
8463.de: Half-figure of an elderly woman en face, body turned to the left, right hand in front. Cap, collar and cuffs white, a brooch on the dark dress.

8665.d: 3/4 profiilis vasakule tumedas kuues vanema mehe rinnapilt.
8665.de: Bust portrait of an elderly man in a dark coat, in 3/4 profile to the left.

8697.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu, mille vasakult poolelt kuni pildi keskosani ulatuva kalda äärsel kivil kükitav tütarlaps, allapoole väljasirutatud paremas käes oleva savikannuga vett võtmas. Taustaks lehtpuud.
8697.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water, on the bank of which, extending from the left side to the centre of the picture, a girl crouches on a stone, drawing water with a clay jug held in her outstretched right hand below her. Deciduous trees in the background.

8715.d: Tänavanurk viilkatustega majadega. Esiplaanil oleva majadegrupi kõrval posti otsas latern. Vasakul valge kivimaja.
8715.de: Street corner with gable-roofed houses. Next to the group of houses in the foreground a lantern on top of a post. On the left a white stone house.

8738.d: Pruunijuukselise laulva tütarlapse poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule. Peas roheline turban, seljas valge, rindu paljaksjättev pluus. Selle üle tumelilla rüü. Paremas käes kokkukeeratud noodirull, vasakus avatud noodileht.
8738.de: Half-figure of a brown-haired singing girl in half-profile to the left. On her head a green turban, wearing a white blouse leaving the chest bare. Over it a dark purple robe. In her right hand a rolled-up sheet of music, in her left an open sheet of music.

8854.d: Eesti rahvariietes noore neiu rindportree. En face, kerge pöördega paremale; lahtised juuksed, peas kõrge pruuditanu rippuvate lintidega. Parem käsi hoiab sõrmust.
8854.de: Bust portrait of a young girl in Estonian folk costume. En face, with a slight turn to the right; loose hair, a tall bridal cap with hanging ribbons on her head. Her right hand holds a ring.

8925.d: Vanema mehe pea, pöördes alla vasakule. Valged juuksed ja habe.
8925.de: Head of an older man, turned down to the left. White hair and beard.

8926.d: Esiplaanil paremal tasandik, vasakul küngas, nende vahel keskel üksik puu. Tagapool mäed. Taamal lumekattes mäes.
8926.de: In the foreground on the right a plain, on the left a hill, between them in the middle a single tree. Mountains behind. In the distance a snow-covered mountain.

9114.d: Eesti rahvarõivais noore naise rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Peas pottmüts, lahtised juuksed.
9114.de: Chest portrait of a young woman in Estonian folk costume, almost en face. Pot-shaped cap on head, loose hair.

9192.d: Ristilöödust paremal, profiilis vasakul põlvili naine. Parema käega laubale toetatud pea on allapoole kallutatud. Ristilöödust vasakul mehe ja naise figuurid. Mees toetab tahapoole langevat naist, mehe parem käsi hoiab naise paremat kätt. Ristil ülaosas pooleldi rullunud papüüros kirjaga:
9192.de: To the right of the crucifixion, in profile, a kneeling woman on the left. Her head, supported by the right hand at the forehead, is inclined downward. To the left of the crucifixion, the figures of a man and a woman. The man supports the woman as she falls backward, the man's right hand holding the woman's right hand. At the top of the cross a half-unrolled papyrus scroll with an inscription:

9196.d: Tumedal foonil mustas kleidis vanema naise poolfiguur, käed vaheliti rinnal. Ühes käes võtmekimp. Peas punasest riidest tanu, pitskaunistustega.
9196.de: Half-figure of an older woman in a black dress against a dark background, hands crossed on the chest. In one hand a bunch of keys. On her head a red cloth bonnet with lace trimmings.

9334.d: Vasakule avaneva kaljukoopa suus väikesel, paremalt järsult tahapoole langeval platool, suunaga koopast välja astuvas asendis, täishabemega, alasti mehekuju - Herakles. Peas ja turjal peakatet ja lahtiselt rippuvat mantlit moodustav suur lõvinahk. Tugeva muskulatuuriga vägilase tõstetud paremas käes õlale toetuvana suur puust sõjanui; vasak, allapoole sirutatud käsi rebib enese järele tulema suurt, tõrksat, paljastatud kihvadega kolmepäist koera - Kerberost. Taustaks koopa seinad ja lagi - ülaosas tumedais toonides, mis allapoole helenevad kaljujärsaku serva tagant paistvaks punaseks põrgutule kumaks. Vasakul nähtavast koopasuust paistab hämarduv taevas.
9334.de: In the mouth of a cave opening to the left, on a small plateau falling steeply backward on the right, in a pose of stepping out of the cave, a bearded, naked male figure - Heracles. On his head and shoulders a large lion skin forming a headcover and a loosely hanging cloak. In the raised right hand of the strongly muscled hero, resting on his shoulder, a large wooden war club; his left hand, stretched downward, drags after him a large, resistant, three-headed dog with bared fangs - Cerberus. The background consists of the cave's walls and ceiling - dark in tone at the top, lightening downward into a red glow of hellfire visible beyond the edge of the cliff. Beyond the visible cave mouth on the left, a darkening sky can be seen.

9505.d: Noore naise poolfiguur istuvas asendis, pea kerges pöördes paremale. Mustad, keskelt lahku kammitud juuksed. Punane kleit, õlgadel läbipaistev tikitud tüll-sall. Kaelas valged helmed. Vasak käsi toetumas tamburiinile.
9505.de: Half-figure of a young woman in a seated position, head slightly turned to the right. Black hair combed apart in the middle. Red dress, on the shoulders a transparent embroidered tulle shawl. White beads around the neck. Left hand resting on a tambourine.

9705.d: Mingisugusel astmel istuva vanema habemiku mehe figuur poolprofiilis vasakule, parem jalg tõstetud kõrgemale, kerge joonega märgitud astmele, selle põlvele toetub pead toetava parema käe küünarnukk. Vasak käsi süles. Mehe riietuseks karusest riidest hallid põlvpüksid, punakat tooni kuub ja punane vest, peakatteks laiaääreline, kirju paelaga kaunistatud kaabu.
9705.de: The figure of an older bearded man sitting on some kind of step, in three-quarter profile to the left, right leg raised higher, marked with a light line on the step, on the knee of which rests the elbow of the right hand supporting the head. Left hand in his lap. The man's clothing consists of grey knee breeches of a furry fabric, a reddish coat and a red waistcoat, and a broad-brimmed hat decorated with a colourful ribbon as headgear.

9714.d: Hallijuukselise, pika täishabeme ja sorakil vurrudega vanamehe pea poolprofiilis paremale, vaade suunatud üles.
9714.de: Head of a grey-haired old man with a long full beard and unkempt moustache, in half-profile to the right, gaze directed upward.

9715.d: Esiplaanil vasakul rahvariides istuv naisefiguur, pea pööratud paremale. Keskel võlvitud värava all seisev rahvariides naisefiguur, paremas käes sirp, vasak käsi toetub väravale. tagaplaanil näha heledalt valgustatud rukkipõld ja maastik kaugete metsadega.
9715.de: In the foreground on the left a seated female figure in folk costume, head turned to the right. In the middle, under an arched gate, a standing female figure in folk costume, a sickle in her right hand, left hand resting on the gate. In the background a brightly lit rye field and a landscape with distant forests can be seen.

9772.d: Noore naise rinnapilt profiilis paremale. Seljas valge, pitsääristusega pluus ja rohekashall pihik, mille õlapael libisenud üle õla. Peakatteks valge rätt. Ehteks korallkõrvarõngad ja kaelakee.
9772.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in profile facing right. Wearing a white lace-trimmed blouse and a greenish-grey bodice, the shoulder strap of which has slipped off the shoulder. Headwear a white kerchief. Jewellery consists of coral earrings and a necklace.

9774.d: Keskealise naise portree visand profiilis paremale. Brünettides juustes roosa ehe.
9774.de: Sketch of a portrait of a middle-aged woman in profile to the right. A pink ornament in her brunette hair.

9783.d: Vasakul pildipoolel kõrge künka jalam ülalpool suurte põõsaste, kahe väikese lehtpuu ja liivakivirahnuga. Tagaplaanil kaks lehtpuud ja silmapiiril paremal puudesalu. Helesinine taevas valgete ja hallide pilverüngastega. Künka jalam ulatub järsu, peaaegu püstloodis seinana esiplaanil diagonaalselt voolava madala kivise allikani, mis kaob varjuliste puude ja põõsaste vahele esiplaanil maali paremal poolel. Allikal küljega vaataja poole tütarlaps valges pluusis ja punases vestis, anumaga käes.
9783.de: On the left side of the picture the foot of a high hill above large bushes, two small deciduous trees and a sandstone boulder. In the background two deciduous trees and a grove of trees on the horizon to the right. Light blue sky with white and grey cumulus clouds. The foot of the hill extends as a steep, almost vertical wall to a low stony stream flowing diagonally in the foreground, which disappears between shaded trees and bushes in the foreground on the right side of the painting. At the stream, in profile facing the viewer, a girl in a white blouse and red vest, holding a vessel.

9802.d: Mägimaastiku taustal pikkade allarippuvate vurrudega keskealise paraadvormi riietatud mehe rinnapilt, pöördega kergelt vasakule. Mehel rinnas ja kaelas ordenid ja üle rinna lai punane kollase ääristusega ordeni pael.
9802.de: Against the background of a mountain landscape, bust portrait of a middle-aged man with long drooping moustaches, wearing a parade uniform, turned slightly to the left. On the man's chest and around his neck orders, and across the chest a broad red order ribbon with a yellow border.

9872.d: Samblaroheline lage maastik. Esiplaanil vasakul torni varemed, paremal osa müürist lillakashalli mäeaheliku taustal. Silmapiiril vasakul lumiste mägede tipud. Kõrge selge taevas, hommikupäikese kollakas kuma mägede piiril ja müürijuppidel.
9872.de: A moss-green bare landscape. In the foreground on the left ruins of a tower, on the right part of a wall against the background of a purplish-grey mountain range. On the horizon on the left snowy mountain peaks. A high clear sky, the yellowish glow of the morning sun on the edge of the mountains and on the pieces of wall.

9922.d: Keskealise mehe rinnapilt, kolmveerand profiilis vasakule.
9922.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man, three-quarter profile to the left.

9926.d: Tugeva musklilise kehaga mehe täisfiguur, kes vasaku käega hoiab kolmepealist looma; paremas käes õlale tõstetud nui.
9926.de: Full figure of a man with a strong muscular body, holding a three-headed animal with his left hand; in his right hand a club raised to shoulder level.

9930.d: Keskel tornitaolised varemed. Esiplaanil vasakul ratsanik kahte härga ajamas.
9930.de: In the middle tower-like ruins. In the foreground on the left a horseman driving two oxen.

9931.d: Noore naise pea en face, vaade üles, mustad kohevad juuksed. Juustes kaks rida pärleid.
9931.de: Head of a young woman en face, gaze upwards, black fluffy hair. Two rows of pearls in the hair.

9995.d: Tütarlapse poolfiguur istuvas asendis, suunaga vasakule. Seljas valge pluus ja punane, rohelise ääristusega pihik. Peakatteks valge rätt.(eesti)
9995.de: Half-figure of a girl in a sitting position, facing left. Wearing a white blouse and a red pinafore trimmed in green. Headwear a white kerchief.

10061.d: Pruunil laual ja beezil foonil madalas klaasis lillad, punased ja valged levkoid.
10061.de: On a brown table and beige background, in a low glass, purple, red and white stocks.

10090.d: Võlvitud väravaaval seisev rahvarõivais ja sirbiga naise figuur, kelle ees samuti rahvarõivais istuva naise figuur. Väravat ümbritsevad lilled ja lehestik. Taamal avaneb vaade päikesepaistelisele põllule.
10090.de: A figure of a woman in folk costume with a sickle, standing under an arched gate opening, before whom sits another figure of a woman also in folk costume. The gate is surrounded by flowers and foliage. In the distance a view opens onto a sunlit field.

10215.d: Istuv vanaeit poolprofiilis vasakule, käed toetumas ettesirutatult põlvedele, kuhu langeb vasakult, väljaspool pildipinda asuvast koldest, tulehelki, mis vähesel määral valgustab ka eide nägu. Eide pead katab valge lahtine rätt, seljas rohekat tooni pihikuga seelik ja põll, mille halli tooni täiendab allosas oranž-kollane riba.
10215.de: An old woman sits in half-profile to the left, her hands resting outstretched on her knees, onto which falls firelight from a hearth located outside the picture plane on the left, which also slightly illuminates the old woman's face. The old woman's head is covered with a loose white kerchief; she wears a skirt with a greenish-toned bodice and an apron, whose grey tone is complemented at the bottom by an orange-yellow strip.

10778.d: Tumedajuukselise naise rinnapilt en face, mustas valge pitskraega kleidis. Kujutatud ovaalis.
10778.de: Chest portrait of a dark-haired woman en face, in a black dress with a white lace collar. Depicted in an oval.

11043.d: Hämaras interjööris paremal neli naist, keskel istuv ja kaks žestikuleerivat meest, vasakul kaks seisvat ja üks põlvitav mees. Seinal ripuvad relvad, paremal ikoon, vasakul aknaava.
11043.de: In a dim interior, on the right four women, in the middle a seated man and two gesturing men, on the left two standing men and one kneeling man. Weapons hang on the wall, on the right an icon, on the left a window opening.

11073.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kõrge merekallas lahesoppide ja üksiku männiga, keskel üle järsaku suvilahooned rohelises, paremal puude all lõkketuli lõbutseva seltskonnaga, taeva foonil Tallinna siluett.
11073.de: In the foreground on the left a high sea bank with bay inlets and a solitary pine, in the middle summer cottage buildings above the cliff amid greenery, on the right a bonfire under trees with a merry company, against the sky the silhouette of Tallinn.

25532.d: Tartu Ülikooli aula piduliku aktuse ajal. Saali põhjaseina, paigutatud kõnepuldi mõlemal küljel seisavad palmid. Kõnepuldis kõneleja, temast mõlemal pool kaks üliõpilast auvalves. Puldi vastas, näoga selle poole, istuvad kuulajad. Kümme toolirida, lisaks kohad poolkaares kahel pool kõnepulti. Ukse juures seisab kepiga pedell. Aula külgedel seisavad vormirõivastuses üliõpilased. Puldi kohal tsaar Nikolai I elusuurune barokses kuldraamis portree. Vasakul, ustega varustatud seinal, Aleksander I elusuurune portree. Joonia kapiteelidega sambad kannavad rõdu, mis on täis daame. Sammaste ja rõdu allääre külge on kinnitatud vanikud. (eesti)
25532.de: During a festive ceremony in the assembly hall of the University of Tartu. On the north wall of the hall, palms are placed on both sides of the lectern. A speaker at the lectern, with two students standing guard of honour on either side of him. Facing the lectern, the audience is seated. Ten rows of chairs, plus seats arranged in a semicircle on both sides of the lectern. A beadle with a staff stands by the door. Uniformed students stand along the sides of the assembly hall. Above the lectern, a life-size portrait of Tsar Nicholas I in a baroque gilded frame. On the left, on a wall fitted with doors, a life-size portrait of Alexander I. Columns with Ionic capitals support a balcony full of ladies. Garlands are attached to the columns and to the lower edge of the balcony. (eesti)

25673.d: Keskel põline kahe haruga pärn, parempoolne haru kaldub algul maha, siis üles. Vasakul ees roigasaed. Eest tahapoole kulgeb roobastee, mis tagapool kaheks hargneb. Taga paistab roigasaiaga piiratud õu, kus kõrge õlgedest sadulkatus ja hoone kõrval vana pärn. Keskel ja paremal silmapiiril noor mets. Paremal madal muruga kaetud oja, kaldal istub poisike, kaap-kübar peas, seljas punane vest, jalas beežid püksid, käes kepp. Oja madalas vees joovad kaks lehma.(eesti)
25673.de: In the middle an old lime tree with two branches, the right branch first bends down, then rises. On the left in front a pole fence. From the front a rail track runs backward, which further back forks into two. At the back a yard enclosed by a pole fence is visible, where a high thatched saddle roof and an old lime tree next to the building. In the middle and on the right on the horizon young forest. On the right a low grass-covered brook, on the bank a boy sits, wearing a peaked cap, a red waistcoat, beige trousers, a stick in his hand. In the shallow water of the brook two cows are drinking.

25684.d: Esiplaanil roigastaraga piiratud talu. Tara nurga taga suur põlispuu. Vasakul ees mõned suured kivid ja okaspuujändrikud. Keskel ees kaks lehma rohumaal. Neist paremal taradega piiratud tänav. Paremal suur kõrge õlgkatusega, korstnata palkmaja. Tagaplaanil sopiline järv saartega, üle järve künklik kallas.(eesti)
25684.de: In the foreground a farm enclosed by a pole fence. Behind the corner of the fence a large ancient tree. On the left in front some large stones and stunted conifers. In the centre in front two cows on a meadow. To the right of them a lane enclosed by fences. On the right a large, high, straw-roofed log house without a chimney. In the background a bay-indented lake with islands, across the lake a hilly shore.
